Shanghai Municipal Council Report 1922

Report for the Year 1922 and Budget for the Year 1923
Shanghai Municipal Council, Shanghai, 1923

All tables and lists are transcribed, including small tables set in the text, the figures printed on charts, the fold-out fire and Mixed Court returns, the staff list, the accounts and the budget (each department or sub-head of the financial statement and budget is a separate table); the prose, the photographs, maps and graphs without printed figures, and the index are not. The scan ends at p. 44D, part-way through the Extraordinary Expenditure of the 1923 budget, so the rest of the budget is missing. An errata slip (two fee corrections, Tls. 2 to Tls. 1.50) is attached as a note where it falls in a table. Table pages were found from contact sheets by Claude Sonnet 5.5; light pages were read once by Claude Haiku 5.5, dense pages, fold-outs and long schedules by Claude Sonnet 5.5. Not checked by eye. Printed totals were re-added by the readers: totals that do not add up are kept as printed and noted. Figures that could not be read are marked [?] (19 cells). Chapters follow the printed contents (four page series, 1A–361A, 1B–86B, 1C–87C and 1D–44D, as printed).
